title: 涂鸦机兵 电脑版 3.2.1 · 维护更新
intro: 修复抽到驾驶员时的登场画面点不掉的问题。
intro_en: Fixes the pilot reveal screen that couldn't be dismissed.

items: 开宝箱抽到驾驶员时，登场画面点击没反应、关不掉 —— 现在点一下跳到最后一幕，再点一下关闭
登场画面也可以用空格 / 回车跳过，Esc 直接关闭
items_en: The pilot reveal after opening a chest ignored clicks and couldn't be closed — now one click skips to the end and another closes it
Space / Enter also skips the reveal, and Esc closes it

title: 涂鸦机兵 电脑版 3.2 · AI 大改 + 模型立绘重做
title_en: GraffiBots PC 3.2 · AI Overhaul + New Models & Art
intro: AI 分成 5 档，每个模式都知道该干什么；全部驾驶员和机体的 3D 模型重做；24 位驾驶员换上全新立绘和头像，抽到时有专属登场动画；隐身终于藏得住了；还加了帧率显示。
intro_en: AI now comes in 5 tiers and understands every mode; all pilot and mech 3D models are rebuilt; all 24 pilots get brand-new art and avatars with a reveal animation; stealth actually hides you now; plus an FPS counter.

items: 菜鸟 / 正常玩家 / 有点实力 / 高手 / 大神：反应、准度、提前量、走位、闪避、技能和超载时机、残血撤退都不一样
高手和大神会优先集火残血、用真实弹速算提前量；大神残血时会变滚轮溜回己方涂料回血；菜鸟偶尔会发呆
普通赛按等级、排位赛按段位决定会遇到哪档 AI
items_en: Rookie / Casual / Skilled / Expert / Godlike: reaction, aim, leading, strafing, dodging, skill and overload timing and retreating all differ
Experts and Godlikes focus low-HP targets and lead with real projectile speed; Godlikes roll away to heal on their own paint; Rookies sometimes zone out
Which tiers you meet depends on your level (normal) or rank (ranked)

items: 据点：所有 AI 都会去抢点、在点里横移不出圈（在点时间几乎翻倍）
乐园：大部分 AI 跟着花车得分，顺路才打气球；护送：持宝者直奔终点，队友护送，敌人追持宝者
电池掠夺：满载就回家存；漆弹足球：球能打就先打球；逃亡圈：先躲毒圈再打架
items_en: Zone: every AI goes for the zone and strafes inside it (almost double the time on point)
Park: most AIs ride with the float and only pop balloons on the way; Escort: carriers head straight for the goal, allies escort, enemies chase
Battery: full carriers go home to bank; Soccer: shoot the ball first; Escape: stay in the circle before fighting

items: 24 位驾驶员全部重画：偏写实的粗墨线画风、低饱和配色加一个主题色，每个人长相、发型、衣服都拉开了，不再撞脸
头像同步换新，背景加上了主题色笔刷、网点、墨点和档案框线
开宝箱抽到驾驶员时：刀光划过 → 背景砸进来 → 剪影滑入 → 白闪上色 → 名字登场 → 最后弹出头像（点一下可以直接跳到结尾）
items_en: All 24 pilots redrawn: semi-realistic heavy-ink style, muted palette with one accent color, and clearly different faces, hair and outfits — no more look-alikes
Avatars redone too, with accent brush strokes, halftone, ink splats and file-frame details in the background

Getting a pilot from a chest now plays a reveal: a slash, the background slams in, the silhouette slides in, a flash colors it, the name lands, and finally the avatar pops up (click to skip to the end)

items: AI 看不见隐身 / 草丛里的你就不能直接锁定；光学迷彩和墨雾只有几乎贴脸才会被发现
有点实力以上的 AI 会按你最后出现的位置揣测、试探性开火，时间越久越不准；正常玩家只会过去看一眼
items_en: AIs can no longer lock onto you while you're stealthed or in a bush; cloak and ink smoke are only revealed at point-blank range
Skilled+ AIs guess from your last seen position and fire probing shots that get less accurate over time; Casuals just go take a look

items: 全部 24 位驾驶员：Q 版比例的完整人物，分层的眼睛和表情、11 种发型、每套衣服都有专属细节（外套下摆、兜帽、披风、围巾、护甲、背包……）
全部 25 台机体：按定位分轻型 / 重装 / 炮台 / 刺客 / 支援底盘，加上履带和悬浮推进；圆角装甲、胸甲徽记、左臂、背包和天线各不相同
开到新驾驶员时有全屏亮相（立绘 + 头像 + 台词）
items_en: All 24 pilots: full chibi characters with layered eyes and expressions, 11 hairstyles and outfit-specific details (coat tails, hoods, capes, scarves, armor, backpacks...)
All 25 mechs: scout / brawler / artillery / striker / support chassis plus treads and hover units, with rounded armor, chest emblems, a left arm and unique backpacks and antennas
Unlocking a new pilot now plays a full-screen reveal (portrait, avatar and quote)

items: 左上角显示帧率（设置 → 画面 → 显示帧率 可以关掉）
items_en: FPS counter in the top-left corner (Settings → Display → Show FPS to turn it off)

title: 涂鸦机兵 电脑版 3.1.1 · 维护更新
intro: 根据大家的反馈做了三项改进：击杀大通知、Tab 战绩表、胜负大字。
intro_en: Three improvements from your feedback: kill announcements, a Tab scoreboard and a win/lose splash.

items: 击倒驾驶员时屏幕中间跳出大通知（击杀者头像 → 被击倒者头像），还有「第一滴血」「双杀 / 三杀 / 四杀 / 五杀！暴走！」；被击倒时也会提示是谁干的
机体被打爆是另一种通知：橙色警示条 + 碎掉的机甲图标（「机体击毁！」/「你的机体被打爆了」），不算进连杀
按住 Tab 查看战绩：每个人的驾驶员 / 机体、击毁、倒下、涂地和表现分（搜刮撤离里 Tab 还是背包）
对局结束先跳出「你胜利了！」/「你失败了」大字动画，再进入结算
items_en: Taking down a pilot shows a big center-screen announcement (killer portrait → victim), plus First Blood and Double / Triple / Quadra / Penta Kill; you also see who took you down
A destroyed mech gets its own announcement: an orange hazard band with a broken-mech icon (Mech Destroyed! / Your mech was destroyed); it doesn't count toward kill streaks
Hold Tab for the scoreboard: everyone's pilot / mech, takedowns, deaths, paint and score (Tab is still the backpack in Loot & Extract)
Matches now end with a big You won! / You lost splash before the results screen

title: 涂鸦机兵 电脑版 3.1 ·「黎明之后」联动
intro: 长夜结束后的第一个清晨，拂晓站的陆行列车「启明号」停在了灰城外。三位全新干员、三台全新机甲、专属手书剧情和 1 分钟联动战斗影片同时上线；14 张地图全部重新设计，画面的光污染也收住了。联动礼包已经寄到邮箱！
intro_en: On the first morning after the Long Night, Daybreak Station's land-train Morningstar stopped outside Gray City. Three new operators, three new mechs, a hand-drawn story and a 1-minute collab battle film are live — plus all 14 maps redesigned and much less light pollution. A collab gift is in your mailbox!

items: 专属活动页（大厅左边的「黎明之后」）：剧情 / 活动任务 / 兑换 / 干员档案
6 话专属手书剧情：铅笔线稿 + 线条抖动的手书风格，做任务一话话解锁，首次观看送晨光碎片
1 分钟联动战斗影片：三位干员对战 Boss「黑日残影」，在活动页随时重看
新货币「晨光碎片」：每局都给，赢了和用联动角色更多；熹微 + 晨轮机兵做任务免费拿，尾声 + 共鸣机兵碎片兑换，宵 + 守夜机兵宝石购买或打通终章任务
items_en: A dedicated event page (After Dawn, left side of the lobby): Story / Quests / Exchange / Dossiers
6 hand-drawn story chapters with a boiling pencil-line look, unlocked by quests; first viewing gives Dawn Shards
A 1-minute collab battle film: the three operators vs the boss Shadow of the Black Sun, replayable on the event page
New currency Dawn Shards from every match (more for wins and collab characters): Glimmer + Halo free from quests, Coda + Chord via shards, Xiao + Vigil via gems or the final quest

sections.h: 三位新干员（机制比以往都复杂，伤害主要靠被动叠出来）
sections.h_en: Three new operators (more complex than ever, damage comes from passives)
items: 熹微 · 拾光者：脚下的日晷在 破晓 / 正午 / 黄昏 / 夜 之间循环，正午叠灼光、黄昏引爆，每转一圈叠一层日轮；技能「定晷」冻结阶段，超载「永昼」四个阶段一起生效
尾声 · 残响者：伤害的 35% 记成回响，2.5 秒后变成真实伤害重演；技能「回溯」回到 2.5 秒前并引爆回响；超载「回声剧场」
宵 · 守夜人：受到的伤害先记成夜债慢慢偿还，背着夜债伤害更高，击倒敌人清账换护盾；技能「清偿」引爆夜债，超载「无月之夜」
终结技「绝响」：尾声驾驶共鸣机兵、余韵叠满 5 层时，大招变成终结技，锁定一个敌人进入只有两人能看见的终章动画，结束时无视机甲直接击倒驾驶员
items_en: Glimmer · Lightcatcher: a sundial cycles Dawn / Noon / Dusk / Night — Noon stacks Glare, Dusk detonates it, each full cycle adds a Sun Ring; skill Sundial Lock freezes a phase, overload Eternal Day runs all four at once
Coda · Reverb: 35% of damage is stored as Echo and replays as true damage after 2.5 s; skill Rewind jumps back 2.5 s and detonates echoes; overload Echo Theater
Xiao · Nightwatch: damage taken becomes Night Debt paid off over time, more debt means more damage, takedowns clear it into shields; skill Settle detonates the debt, overload Moonless Night

Finisher Final Note: Coda in the Chord mech with 5 Resonance stacks turns the super into a finisher — lock one enemy into a cutscene only the two of you see, then down their pilot outright, mech or not

items: 晨轮机兵：扔出会飞回来的光轮，来回都穿透、回程伤害 ×1.4、来回都中会致盲；大招「日冕环」
共鸣机兵：共鸣索拴住敌人持续吸血，越拴越疼，会分叉连到旁边的人；大招「谐振网」让被拴的人分担伤害
守夜机兵：点按两连斩，按住举夜幕盾，松开反斩（伤害 = 挡下的伤害），举盾瞬间挨打是完美格挡；大招「长夜」让敌人看不远
items_en: Halo mech: a returning light disc that pierces both ways, ×1.4 on the way back, and blinds on a double hit; super Corona Ring
Chord mech: a resonance tether that drains more the longer it holds and forks to nearby enemies; super Harmonic Web shares damage between linked enemies
Vigil mech: tap for a two-hit combo, hold to raise the Night Shield, release to counter for the damage blocked; a hit right as you raise it is a perfect parry; super Long Night shrinks enemy vision

items: 新布局：火车分道的晨光车站、楼顶群岛、钟楼环台、集装箱迷宫、梯田矿坑、地下站台……每张图的结构都不一样
每张图有自己的主题：地面花纹、墙面材质、草丛、场外远景、灯光和天气（雪、花瓣、火星、尘埃）各不相同
新联动地图「拂晓荒原」：沙丘、锈蚀列车残骸和夜蚀结晶
items_en: New layouts: a rail yard split by trains, rooftop islands, a clock-tower ring, a container maze, a terraced quarry, a metro platform... every map plays differently
Each map has its own look: ground patterns, wall materials, foliage, backdrop, lighting and weather (snow, petals, embers, dust)
New collab map Daybreak Wastes: dunes, a rusted land-train wreck and nightrot crystals

items: 光污染大幅降低：泛光、霓虹边、发光材质和彩色点光源都收住了，颜色更自然
「夜都决战」联动下架：咒灵讨伐、封印争夺两个限时玩法关闭，符零 / 赤镰 / 结界机兵 / 灵刃机兵暂时绝版（已拥有的照常使用）
items_en: Much less light pollution: bloom, neon edges, emissive materials and colored point lights are toned down for more natural colors
The Night City collab is over: Spirit Raid and Seal Clash are closed; Fu Ling / Akakama / Warden / Reaper are retired for now (owners keep them)

title: 涂鸦机兵 电脑版 3.0 正式版上线
intro: 网页版的全部内容都搬到电脑版了，还多了很多只有电脑版才有的东西。上线礼包已经寄到邮箱，记得领取！
intro_en: Everything from the web version is now on PC, plus lots of PC-only features. A launch gift is waiting in your mailbox!

items: 全部 22 台机体、21 位驾驶员、14 张地图和 12 种模式（含排位赛和搜刮撤离）
通行证、邮件、任务线、限时活动、皮肤商店、天赋、宝箱，账号和网页版通用（转移码互导）
items_en: All 22 mechs, 21 pilots, 14 maps and 12 modes (including Ranked and Loot & Extract)
Pass, mail, questlines, events, skin shop, talents and chests; accounts are shared with the web version (transfer codes)

items: 匹配对手 → 准备确认（有人没准备会重新匹配）→ 排位禁用 / 选人（中间放 3D 模型）→ VS 载入 → 观察阶段
AI 有性格、昵称和外观，对局里会聊天、回你的话；结算有 MVP / 钻石 / 黄金 / 白银 / 青铜评级
items_en: Matchmaking → ready check (no-shows trigger a re-queue) → ranked bans / picks with 3D models → VS loading → observe phase
AI players have personalities, nicknames and looks, chat in matches and reply to you; results show MVP / Diamond / Gold / Silver / Bronze ratings

items: 局域网联机，以及通过游戏服务器的线上房间（输入房间号加入），所有模式都能一起打，包括组队排位和搜刮撤离
好友码加好友、在线状态、一键邀请组队；对局聊天（Enter）
items_en: LAN play and online rooms through a game server (join with a room code) in every mode, including party Ranked and Loot & Extract
Friend codes, online status, one-click party invites; in-match chat (Enter)

items: 消耗品（1~4 键或双击使用）、N 键大地图、全灭的小队位置会有增援小队空降
交易行（价格每小时浮动）和本周撤离排行
items_en: Consumables (keys 1–4 or double-click), big map with N, reinforcement squads drop into wiped squad slots
Market with hourly prices and a weekly extraction leaderboard

items: 个人资料：头像、动态头像框、称号、签名、生涯战绩、3 格展示框
新手教程、赛季开场动画、皮肤进场特效、暂停菜单、手柄、中文 / English、自动检查更新
items_en: Profile: avatar, animated frames, titles, signature, career stats and a 3-slot showcase
Tutorial, season intro, skin entrance effects, pause menu, gamepad, 中文 / English, automatic update check
